SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(s.shipment_id is not null), sum(s.delivered_ts is not null), (select count(*) from payments p where p.order_id in (select order_id from orders where status=o.status)) pays FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
